transcriber_notes: Rows: 5 + 5 as printed (昭和4-8) in two parts. In the opium part the tiny label '年度' is printed above 昭和 4; the sugar part carries '(自前年11月至10月)' above 昭和 4.
Unit glyph read as 瓩 (kilogram) in the title; 阿片 原料 數量 unit assumed from the title (阿片瓩) — the column itself prints no unit. 烟膏 columns: 數量/價額 unit not printed beyond the title.

Sugar: 總數 數量 = 分蜜糖 + 含蜜糖 in 昭和5-8 (reconciles; 昭和4: 777,931+11,397 = 789,328 vs printed 789,329, diff 1); 糖蜜 is not part of the sum. 總數 價額 = 分蜜+含蜜 價額 in 昭和5-8 (昭和4: 149,082+1,797 = 150,879 vs 150,878, diff 1).
Opium: 吸飮特許者 總數 = 臺灣人 男+女 + 支那人 男+女 in all five years (reconciles).
Row '昭和 6', col '五瓦入烟膏 — 價額': printed 1,171 while the 數量 beside it is a dash; kept as printed.

en.t: Sugar and Opium Manufacture in Taiwan
en.d: Gives the quantity and value of centrifugal sugar, non-centrifugal sugar and molasses produced in Taiwan and of opium preparations, by year.
